item.title: Microsoft Agent Framework for .NET (part 1): what it is, how it works, and when to use it
item.description: Microsoft Agent Framework is Microsoft’s production-oriented framework for building AI agents and multi-agent workflows in .NET and Python. Let’s see how it works, why Microsoft created it, and when to choose it over Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or AutoGen. Link to article: https://www.code4it.dev/blog/introduction-microsoft-agent-framework-dotnet/

item.title: No more regressions with Snapshot Tests in C# using Verify: a practical guide
item.description: Snapshot Tests are an uncommon type of test that focuses on checking that no regressions were introduced after a code refactoring. Let’s learn how they work and how to use the Verify NuGet library to add them to your test suite. Link to article: https://www.code4it.dev/blog/snapshot-tests-with-verify/
